name: KKSG29 (Hubble)
blurb: KKSG29, a faint dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: leda42120-hubble
story: A faint, ragged dwarf galaxy that sits near the Sombrero Galaxy on the sky. Hubble resolved its red giant stars to measure its distance, and its motion differs from the Sombrero's.

claims.text: KKSG29 is a low surface brightness dwarf irregular galaxy and a neighbor of NGC 4594, the Sombrero
The radial velocities of KKSG29 and NGC 4594 differ
Hubble program 14636 measured tip of the red giant branch distances to its galaxies
KKSG29 has a measured TRGB distance
